# widget

## ✨ Highlights

![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)

> [!TIP]
> Render configurable widgets from the command line.

`#cli` `#widgets`

## 📦 Installation

```sh
npm install --global @acme/widget
```

## 🛠 Usage

```sh
widget render --config widget.config.json
```

## 🧑‍💻 Development
